messages:
ivy: Quick heads-up we're running a micro experiment on pricing next week: inline estimator + new mid-tier name + small FAQ tweaks. Goal: fewer Contact Sales clicks, higher self-serve signups. Can we lock owners? noah: I can do the calculator embed. Prefer a tiny JS widget. Prototype:
sara: I'll own FAQ and tier microcopy. Suggest tiers: Starter / Pro / Enterprise. CTA test: 'Estimate your cost' vs baseline 'Get started'. quentin-sales: Routing note: if estimate_usd >= 6000 OR selects 'Enterprise interest' -> AE queue. Add field estimated_segment and webinar_opt_in boolean. Need daily CSV of leads during experiment. leo-eng: Analytics names proposed: rwmini_open, rwmini_submit, rwmini_value_usd, rwmini_contact_click. Will add GA4 + BigQuery mapping and alert on contact_click spike. Can push to staging Tue. compliance-bot: Reminder: use copy "Enterprise plans offer optional SLA-backed support" and label estimates as non-binding. ivy: Timeline: staging Tue, QA Wed, go-live Thu for 21 days. Primary metric = pricing CTA -> signup conversion. Secondary = Contact Sales clicks. Post staging link here and drop final FAQ by Monday. Thanks! :rocket:
